# Shopify Connector for Muse

💳 Paid plan required: this connector needs a paid third-party plan — the listing is free, but usage requires a subscription. See Prerequisites for costs.
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source build (MIT) by @bluman1, listed here with credit to its creator. A Muse agent skill that reads your Shopify store (open orders, products, customers) and writes in exactly two places: create products as drafts and create discounts (a price rule plus a redeemable discount code) — both with exact-match confirmation on every call. There are no order or customer write commands, ever: no money-movement writes exist here by design. No secrets in the repo — credentials stay in Muse's secure vault.
